ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 35% low-intensity black pixels defining the median area and perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel blobs occupy the central-medial regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a wide vertical band at the median notch and narrow contours along the trailing edge. Distinct low-intensity punctate mottling is visible within the white fields, particularly in the distal-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.2 relative to the immediate inner lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels. Serration density is highest at the distal tips and decreases slightly toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the outer tips, creating an attenuated 'wing-tip' profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes and sporadically along the inner trailing edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity linear pixel disruptions detected. Two prominent parallel vertical streaks on the mid-left lobe; several thinner, non-aligned vertical and diagonal streaks on the central-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters forming an irregular, high-contrast encrustation on the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
